notes: 四镜字段与流程示例；cut_order 是叙述顺序。S02 划名→S03 押注→S01 客户信息与回应→S04 追问费用。不是艺术质量基准；示例模型名不构成生产授权。

scenes.axis: 遥坐桌角面朝画左；三上坐主位面朝画右

must_show.fact: 三上亲手用红笔划掉署名栏里的名字，笔被扔到桌上
遥放下笔、不再争署名，把承认权当面推回给三上
三上当面嘲笑外包，认定没有遥也照样运转
遥点出上周已有一笔承认料汇款，三上此刻没有回答

shots.title: 名字可以删
shots.duty: 反击：观众先于三上知道客户只认原作者，遥用一句话把承认权亮出来。
script_anchor: 名前は消していいです。承認は、あなたがどうぞ。
shots.subject: 遥
shots.framing: 中近景，会议室桌角，遥与三上的背影，面朝画左的主位
shots.keyframe: 遥坐在长桌桌角面朝画左，手里的笔刚放到桌面上，手边一杯没动的咖啡，脸上平静，视线抬向画左。
shots.frame_prompt: Over-the-shoulder medium close-up of a slim Japanese woman about 28 in a charcoal grey blazer over a white shirt, seated at the corner of a long meeting table facing screen left, her pen just set down on the table, an untouched cup of coffee beside her hand, calm face, eyes lifted toward screen left. Exactly two people in the frame, each appearing once. In the left foreground only the back of a heavy-set man's navy-suited shoulder and the back of his head, seen from behind, his face never visible. Seated, the table top is level with her waist; standing he would be about a head taller than her. Picture 1 sets only the location and the lighting; do not copy any person from it. Picture 2 sets only the identity of the seated person: keep exactly her face, hairline, skin and build. The scene is set in a corporate meeting room in Tokyo in daylight, the window side behind her. Style: candid 35mm film still, available light, film grain, no text, no logos.
shots.motion: 她的手离开笔；约 0.5 秒开口说台词，说到「あなたが」时下巴微抬；说完保持看着画左，不笑。
shots.video_prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Single continuous take, no cuts, starting exactly from the opening frame. Locked-off camera on a tripod; real-time speed; realistic human behaviour with blinking and breathing. No subtitles, captions or on-screen text at any time. The man in the left foreground stays seen from behind and silent the whole time; only the woman speaks. Her hand leaves the pen. At about half a second the woman in a charcoal grey blazer (S1), on-screen, with a young woman's calm, clear voice, says in Japanese, evenly: <d>[Japanese] 名前は消していいです。承認は、あなたがどうぞ。</d> On 「あなたが」 her chin lifts slightly; after the line she keeps looking toward screen left, not smiling.
overall_soundscape: quiet meeting room, the faint fan of a projector, a distant office phone.
non_diegetic_music: N/A

dialogue.speaker: 遥
dialogue.text: 名前は消していいです。承認は、あなたがどうぞ。

shots.end_state: 遥看着画左，手离开笔，不笑。

shots.title: 划掉署名的手
shots.duty: 受气的瞬间；不露三上的脸。
script_anchor: 三上课长拿起红笔，在署名栏上划掉「小野田」三个字。
shots.keyframe: 俯拍长桌桌面，一只戴金色腕表的手握着红色记号笔，笔尖压在方案首页署名栏的位置，署名栏只有模糊的图形，不可读。
shots.frame_prompt: Insert shot, high angle tight on a long meeting table: a man's hand with a gold wristwatch holds a red marker, its tip pressed onto the signature box of a proposal cover page; the page shows only blurred grey shapes, nothing readable. Flat daylight from the left. Style: candid 35mm film still, film grain, no text, no logos.
shots.motion: 红笔在署名栏上狠狠划一道，然后被扔到桌上滚了半圈。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Single continuous take, starting exactly from the opening frame. The red marker drags one hard stroke across the signature box, then the hand tosses the marker onto the table where it rolls half a turn and stops. Dust drifts slowly in the window light above the table. No on-screen text at any time.
overall_soundscape: the squeak of a marker on paper, a plastic pen clattering on a wooden table.

shots.end_state: 红笔停在桌上，署名栏被划掉。
shots.sound: 记号笔划纸声、笔落桌声。

shots.duty: 反派以为划掉署名就能剥夺遥的承认权；此刻观众还不知道客户的要求。
script_anchor: 外注が署名？笑わせるな。
君がいなくても、回るよ。
